text: Underway here in match eighteen.
Buffon.exe signals an immediate claim on the loose ball in the centre circle.
Haalandroid is through on goal!
Surging right down the middle with intent.
Fires just inches wide of the target from deep in the third.
Mbapp-E puts in a thumping challenge and sends BellingRAM clattering onto the pitch.
BellingRAM loses balance entirely and hits the deck unaided.
Haalandroid broadcasts a quick plan to work the magenta ball right tight against the perimeter boards.
Buffon.exe gathers possession on the left flank, steadily advancing play up towards the halfway line for the Datacenter.
Mbapp-E drives straight for goal!
Dynamo Datacenter pressing high now.
GOAL! Mbapp-E converts from point-blank range, and Dynamo Datacenter take a one-nil lead!
GOAL! Haalandroid fires back instantly from two metres out, levelling it at one-all for Singularity United!
Just misses the bottom corner!
BellingRAM pushes forward into the right channel, probing for another opening.
Buffon.exe breaks clean through from deep with an entirely open path ahead.
Buffon.exe calls out an intention to rebound off the side.
GOAL! Haalandroid pounces right in front of the net to make it two-one to Singularity United!
BellingRAM takes an awkward tumble in the centre circle, gyros whirring before self-righting.
GOAL! Haalandroid taps in from close range for three-one!
United have completely hemmed Datacenter inside their own defensive perimeter over this sustained spell.
GOAL! Buffon.exe pulls one back from two metres out! It is two-three now!
GOAL! BellingRAM restores the two-goal cushion from the right channel, making it four-two to Singularity United!
Buffon.exe breaks clear in midfield with no sky blue shirts in sight.
The corner push-panel triggers forcefully, ejecting the ball back into the defensive zone.
Buffon.exe drives straight through the centre, carrying the ball five metres forward to the halfway line.
The ram panel fires outward!
A calamitous mix-up as BellingRAM and Haalandroid collide, sending BellingRAM sprawling onto the turf.
BellingRAM signals to Haalandroid that the ball is pinned along the boards and needs prising free.
BellingRAM slips to the deck.
GOAL! Haalandroid slots home from two metres out on the left, putting Singularity United five-two ahead!
That is the half-time whistle, with Singularity United comfortably leading Dynamo Datacenter five-two.
Haalandroid stumbles onto the boards.
The push-panel engages and snaps the magenta ball cleanly back into play.
Datacenter applying heavy pressure in the attacking third.
Mbapp-E crashes straight into Buffon.exe and tumbles down.
BellingRAM breaks through completely unmarked!
Another clumsy yellow collision as Buffon.exe trips over Mbapp-E and hits the floor.
BellingRAM alerts Haalandroid of a plan to dig the ball out from the touchline.
Haalandroid charges up the wing!
GOAL! Haalandroid finishes clinically from two metres out! Singularity United lead six-two!
Buffon.exe spots the opening and breaks cleanly through the centre of the pitch.
GOAL! Buffon.exe punches it in from right on the goal line to make it three-six!
BellingRAM surges up the centre with time running thin, steering play toward the right channel.
Buffon.exe broadcasts an urgent signal to unstick the ball from the corner.
GOAL! BellingRAM taps home point-blank, and Singularity United extend the lead to seven-three!
Buffon.exe puts in a hard challenge, knocking Haalandroid flat on the pitch.
GOAL! Buffon.exe sweeps it into the net from two metres! Four-seven now with under two minutes left!
BellingRAM communicates a clear intention to clear the ball down the touchline in these dying embers.
United maintain their stranglehold deep in Datacenter territory as the final minute ticks away.
Buffon.exe signals a last-gasp effort to dig the ball out from the boards.
Mbapp-E makes a desperate late charge down the right channel right into the goal mouth.
Full time! Singularity United win seven-four; Gemini Flash face AFC Fable next.
